notes.text: No real congestion control. Neko never changes its encoder bitrate. Its optional estimator (webrtc.estimator.enabled) only switches between pre-built pipelines, and only for a client that asks for auto, which the 3.2.0 web client never does. It also ignores the browser's keyframe requests, so a lost frame is only repaired by the next scheduled keyframe (1 s). On the WAN its 30 Mbit/s stream overruns the 10 Mbit/s link and the picture freezes. Hand-setting the bitrate under the link's rate was tried (2026-11-07): at 10 Mbit/s the desktop never appeared, and at 9 Mbit/s it appeared but froze (drag and full-width scroll at 0 frames/s, still text SSIM 0.19). Working below its configured bitrate needs a change in Neko itself.
